programme.desc: The Bark Park. Triggs sings about one of his favourite places in the whole world, the dog park, as he and Maddie help a nervous newcomer find her feet and reclaim her roar.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Museum Worker. Dylan the museum worker wants to put on an exciting exhibit, but the subject disappears. He needs to find it and get it back in place before the museum opens.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Treasure Hunt. Ginger wakes the Pea-Rexes with a surprise, a breakfast treasure hunt for yummy drops!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The Dump. On a trip to the dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Pet Badge. The Squirrels meet a Scrufflelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Hey Quacky! Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Parsnip. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Parsnip performing a jaw-dropping escape that would leave even Houdini speechless.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy Goes Bang. After hearing thunder during a storm, Timmy becomes fixated by loud noises, banging anything he can find.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Jud and Lucas Become Friends. Lucas is looking for more friends to play with. Jud suggests a fun-filled game of chase.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Billy Goats. Small is guarding her final biscuit, but Jen wants to eat it too!

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Tapir and Fruit Bat. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet tapirs and fruit bats.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Air Traffic Controller. Air traffic controller Kim shows us how her radar map works and how she uses it to help pilots when they're flying their planes.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Sound Tennis. Guide dog Kika uses her super sight to help Dr Amit and his friend Alana play a game of sound tennis. Kika tries not to chase the noisy balls at the sports centre.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Bridges and Playground Flooring. Maddie learns how a suspension bridge works and finds out how playground flooring is made.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Flower. Dee encourages a friend to say 'flower', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a pink flower, a yellow flower, a frilly flower and silly squirty flowers too!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Six. Children's animation. The Numberblocks make a new friend who likes to roll dice. Learn all about the number 6 with Numberblock Six.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Wish. Educational fun. G is growing wishes but U doesn't believe in them until something big happens and G's watering can ends up in a very high place.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Magic Beans. Go and Stop are given some magic beans and discover that they can make amazingly shaped plants. But which ones look the best?

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Silly Colouring. The Colourblocks discover that it can be fun to colour things wrong. Learn about choosing colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Buddy Badge. Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Daffodil Day. It's the first day of spring, so it's time for the traditional march round the garden to greet the daffodils. But none of the gang can remember the right tempo to march to.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Superheroes. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Justin and his friend pretend to be superheroes. Super Tumble rescues Shopkeeper Tumble, Baker Tumble and Aunt Polly.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Ballet. Preschool series. Dipsy ballet twirls with the Tiddlytubbies, and the children in Tummy Tales put on a ballet show for their family at home.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Australopithecus and Hair. Preschool adventure series. Andy heads back three million years in time, where he runs into some ancient primates and joins their tribe.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Meeting Waffle. Preschool comedy drama series. A newlywed family discover a lost puppy hiding among their wedding presents. Daughter Evie wants to keep him and call him Waffle.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: School Run. Live-action children's show. It's the day before Topsy and Tim visit their new school for the first time. They are excited but wonder how they will travel there each day.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Ooo Ooo Slips Up. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa and the other animals keep slipping up on banana skins littering the floor.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Singing Caterpillar. The Game Catchers land on the Salad Planet to play hurdles relay.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Atmospheric River. Paani and Min use the new Octoblimp to map a 'river in the sky'.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: How to Record Sound. On an exciting trip around planet Proxima, Cosima and Big Lizard record some cosmic nature sounds for Dad.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Peas and Quiet. Supertato and Carrot investigate strange noises in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Food Growing Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee is sowing seeds. The Squirrels ask if they can grow something too. One of the Squirrels is in for an enormous surprise!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Journal's End. Animated series. When Flopsy and Mopsy borrow Peter's journal, Peter has to save them from Old Brown - but will he lose his journal in the process?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Solomon's Exciting Day. Solomon and his friends are practising letters with Miss Gerrard. Later, they have a go on the climbing wall - who will be able to make it across?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Pirate Parade. Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him! Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Ghostbasket. Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Escape. Mum and Dad describe a made-up world where they relax, but Bluey and Bingo burst in!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Gone Bird. Exhausted with requests for help, Looph deliberately disappears. The Piris turn detective, searching the berg with little success until her ingenious plan is finally revealed.

programme.title: New: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Tidy Monitor. Dodge is given the job of tidy monitor, but as he patrols the classroom, he knocks over the class art project. It's a big job to tidy up, and Dodge soon gets bored.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: Waffle's Doggy Disco. A loud disco disrupts after-school club, but George has a solution, so Waffle can join in.

programme.title: New: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Just Like a Puffin. Phoenix eagerly joins puffin practice with Oona, Isabelle and Baba, but he doubts himself when he can't do everything they can.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: It's Time to Go Camping. JoJo's excited to go on her first camping trip with Gran Gran, Uncle Tyrell & Cousin Lexi!

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: A Hole in the Road! Mr Onion is riding on the Bumparoller when he discovers a great big hole in the road. What are we going to do? Mr Onion knows how to fix it!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: The Kindness Tree. Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. Major invents something, but what can it be for? Tiny and Small give him an idea!

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Look What the Ball Did! The ball bounces all over the garden. It accidentally knocks over Makka Pakka's pile of stones, so Makka Pakka rebuilds it and tries to protect it.
